{{Top|leg}}
A '''Voiceprint''' was a type of biometric identifier based on an individual's voice. Voiceprints were used both for personal identification and as a security measure for controlling access to restricted locations.<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] had his voiceprint modified to match that of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] in an effort to deter [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] spies.<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
